headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, driven by AI and steady dividend payouts.
summary: Most major players reported double‑digit revenue growth YoY. TCS and Wipro maintained strong operating margins above 20% and 16% respectively. HCLTech highlighted AI sales as a key driver, while LTM and Tech Mahindra posted the highest YoY revenue gains. Dividend payouts were raised or maintained across the board.

themes.title: AI as growth catalyst
themes.detail: AI‑related revenue rose sharply, with HCLTech reporting a 78% YoY jump and TCS crossing the 10% threshold.

themes.title: Dividend consistency
themes.detail: Most firms declared or increased interim dividends, supporting shareholder returns.

themes.title: Attrition pressure
themes.detail: Attrition remained above 13% at TCS and Wipro, indicating talent retention challenges.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 20% YoY, the highest among peers.
